title: Climate-health-data research overlap
goal: A research office can identify an interdisciplinary early-warning opportunity.

rubric.must: Three labelled research-field sets visibly overlap.
The triple intersection is visibly labelled Early-warning systems.
All three pairwise intersections have visible labels.
Each field has a visible exclusive area label.
The set labels and intersections are readable.

ideal.notes: Independently authored using visual-eval/exemplars/venn/venn/ideal.svg (07e0f59e6164); rendered and visually reviewed. Three equal translucent circles; every exclusive, pairwise and triple region is labelled inside its exact region, with clearance from boundaries. No areas or counts invented.
